decisions.reason: The fifteen-day express program costs little to keep as a delivery option, but it overlaps with the broader express line D, so consolidation is a possibility; while its value is still uncertain, keeping it open is the cheaper choice.
The seventy-two-hour express service is operationally demanding and may be folded into the umbrella express program, but early results do not yet show it lacks value, so the option is kept open.
This European-certified fire-resistant exterior door extends the core modular fire-door system, was featured prominently at BAU, and needs further commitment rather than abandonment.
The multi-model express line has its own page and serves as the strategic umbrella for fast delivery, so the firm will likely invest further rather than drop it.
The digital ordering and services platform supports trade partners and the firm's service-oriented direction, has low marginal cost, and offers high upside, so the option is kept.
The fire and smoke protection door is close to the established certified offer, costs little to keep, and meets steady compliance-driven demand.
